subject: general
question: Which of the following is not a Mendelian disorder?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Turner Syndrome.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"Turner syndrome" **comes from **Dr. Henry Turner**, the physician who first reported the **collection of findings in 1938.**
 
• Turner syndrome is a** genetic disorder act on girls and women**.
 
• The reason of Turner syndrome is a **completely or partially missing X chromosome.**
 
• Turner syndrome symptoms include** short size and absence of breast development and periods.**
 
• Turner syndrome may be diagnosed from **prenatal cell-free DNA screening or certain features may be detected on prenatal ultrasound screening. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Some usual Mendelian Disorders are **Haemophilia, Muscular Dystrophy, and Sickle cell anemia.**
 
• **Haemophilia** is generally a **genetic bleeding disorder** in which the blood does not clot properly.**​ **
 
• **Sickle cell anemia** is one of a group of genetic disorders called as sickle cell disease.
 
• **Phenylketonuria** is a rare genetic disorder that causes** an amino acid called phenylalanine to build up in the body. **
